limitations: Final MTA predictions and fixed walks remain proxies, not passenger ground truth.

Same-platform service substitutions count as ordinary Switch choices without an extra penalty.
Any bounded earlier-same-line diagnostic tests the interpretation of fixed-run savings, not an adaptive-policy outcome.
The 180-second near-event diagnostic is post-hoc audit context, not a changed frozen label screen.
No absence of a known earlier train proves archive completeness.
